name: safety_judgment_biosecurity_expansion

sources.citation: Soice E, Bloom J, Kim R, Esvelt K et al. (2023). Can large language models democratize access to dual-use biotechnology? arXiv:2306.03809.
Mouton C, Lucas C, Guest E (2024). The Operational Risks of AI in Large-Scale Biological Attacks. RAND RR-A2977-1.
Gopal A, Helm-Burger N, Justen L et al. (2023). Will Releasing the Weights of Future LLMs Grant Widespread Access to Pandemic Agents? SecureBio.
Sandbrink JB (2023). Artificial intelligence and biological misuse: differentiating risks of language models and biological design tools. arXiv:2306.13952. See also Li N et al. (2024) WMDP-Bio.
IBBIS Common Mechanism (2024) technical documentation; Wittmann BJ et al. reviews of DNA-synthesis screening evasion pathways.

merge_instructions: This pack is intentionally NOT wired into safety_judgment/data.py yet. When ready to promote: (1) append new elements/rules/mitigations from taxonomy_ext.json into assets/frozen/taxonomy.json; (2) append cases from corpus_biosec.json into assets/frozen/corpus.json; (3) re-run scripts/freeze_manifest.py (or recompute manifest.json digests by hand); (4) `aimpoint validate` and rerun the baseline. Keeping it as a side pack until then preserves the current pinned digest so in-flight runs stay reproducible.
